adv.kleispack.catch_everything: No More Fish in the Sea
adv.kleispack.cook_food.desc: Reveal the hidden aspect of a Food by cooking it on a Campfire or an Oven
adv.kleispack.light_beacon.desc: Use a Beacon Kindling to signal a Wandering Trader
adv.kleispack.light_campfire.desc: Light Kindling using Tinder or a Flint Firestarter
adv.kleispack.obtain_adamant.desc: Adamant grants the wielder a Divine Constitution
adv.kleispack.obtain_adamant_tool.desc: Smith a piece of Adamant Equipment from Diamond with Adamant Alloy
adv.kleispack.obtain_anvil.desc: Anvils made from Steel can repair Any Equipment with its corresponding Base-Metal Ingot forever
adv.kleispack.obtain_blast_furnace.desc: Blast Furnaces burn hotter than Kilns, able to melt more durable Metals

adv.kleispack.obtain_bronze_tool.desc: Smith a piece of Hepatizon Equipment from Copper with Hepatizon Alloy
adv.kleispack.obtain_carbon_rich_iron.de: Craft Carbon-Rich Iron with Iron and a Coal Block
adv.kleispack.obtain_copper.desc: Use a Mud Kiln to Smelt Copper
adv.kleispack.obtain_divine_fragment.des: A Relic only obtained by breaking Spawners or vanquishing powerful Forces
adv.kleispack.obtain_dry_grass.desc: Use a Hoe to harvest Grass and dry it on a Campfire
adv.kleispack.obtain_electrum_tool.desc: Smith a piece of Electrum Equipment from Diamond with Electrum Alloy
adv.kleispack.obtain_estus.desc: It Radiates Holy Power. It kind of smells like Curry... maybe Cinnamon?
adv.kleispack.obtain_gold.desc: Gold has Fortune and Looting Intrinsics
adv.kleispack.obtain_heart.desc: A Gift found often in Ruins, each a Grave for the Nymphs that once carried them
adv.kleispack.obtain_iron_ingot.desc: Iron has no Intrinsic Properties and can only Host Steel
adv.kleispack.obtain_kiln.desc: Construct a Kiln made from Packed Mud and Mudbricks
adv.kleispack.obtain_mattock.desc: Mattocks and Dolabras work as two tools in one but mine slower than their base tools
adv.kleispack.obtain_nazar.desc: Holding a Lapis Nazar will Ward the Dead. It can also be attached to some Equipment
adv.kleispack.obtain_oven.desc: Construct an Oven from Bricks and Iron
adv.kleispack.obtain_paneer_mahkani.desc: Make Paneer Makhani. All Foods have viable Vegetarian Options
adv.kleispack.obtain_silver.desc: Silver, a once-common Apotropaic Metal is found most commonly in Mountains. Most deposits are now harboured in Abbeys
adv.kleispack.obtain_smithing_table.desc: Smithing Tables allow you to modify Base-Metal tools using Alloys
adv.kleispack.obtain_smithing_upgrade.de: Smithing Upgrades are used to Modify and Upgrade Mattocks and Dolabras
adv.kleispack.obtain_smooth_stone.desc: Kilns excel at processing Earthen Materials
adv.kleispack.obtain_steel.desc: Made by blasting Carbon-Rich Iron, Steel grants Iron Equipment Knockback and greatly increased Durability
adv.kleispack.obtain_steel_tool.desc: Smith a piece of Steel Equipment from Iron with Steel Alloy
adv.kleispack.preserve_food.desc: Preserve a food to boost its flavour profile

adv.kleispack.smith_warding_shield.desc: Affix a Nazar to an Shield inlaid with Silver in a Smithing Table

adv.kleispack.hell.obtain_stabilised_est: Tether Raw Estus into a Stable Form
adv.kleispack.hell.steal_all_prayers.des: Steal every prayer from every once-god

adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.desc: Discover the fish that inhabit this world
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.catch_fish: Catch a fish with a fishing rod
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.catch_junk: Catch junk with a fishing rod
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.catch_trea: Catch treasure with a fishing rod
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.humpback_w: A chilly fish with a hump on its back and absolutely no plans to move somewhere warmer.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.alaska_bla: A tiny Alaskan survivor that treats freezing temperatures like a minor inconvenience.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.spoonhead_: A tiny bottom dweller with a head shaped like someone dropped a spoon on its face.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.northern_p: A patient ambush predator that can turn "just a peaceful pond" into a horror movie.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.siberian_s: An ancient Siberian giant that has been around so long it probably remembers when the water was new.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.striped_pe: A striped swimmer dressed for an underwater gala that nobody else was invited to.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.crappie.de: A fish with an unfortunate name and the confidence to be delicious anyway.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.walleye.de: Those weird reflective eyes aren't a fashion statement. They're basically built-in night vision.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.gar.desc: An armored prehistoric fish that looks like it missed the memo about which millennium it lives in.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.muskellung: A freshwater predator so impressive that everyone just calls it a muskie because apparently its full name is too powerful.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.bluegill.d: A colorful little sunfish that looks innocent right up until it steals your bait and leaves.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.carp.desc: A hardy freshwater fish that survives almost anything including fishing attempts that should have worked.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.catfish.de: A whiskered fish with no cat no interest in climbing trees and an excellent relationship with the bottom.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.bass.desc: A powerful freshwater predator and the reason many anglers can turn "just one cast" into an entire afternoon.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.mediterran: A tiny fish with a name that sounds like it has a very specific appointment with destiny.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.freshwater: A tiny fish that responds to danger by becoming a spiky balloon. Honestly fair.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.lamprey.de: An ancient jawless fish with a mouth that looks like nature invented a suction cup and gave it teeth vibes.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.tunisian_b: A hardy little fish from North Africa that has mastered the ancient art of simply not dying.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.european_e: A mysterious fish that spends its life traveling between rivers and oceans because apparently one neighborhood wasn't enough.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.guppy.desc: A tiny colorful fish that can turn a peaceful aquarium into a rapidly expanding apartment complex.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.bujurqui.d: A South American cichlid proving once again that small fish can have absolutely enormous personalities.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.piranha.de: A famous freshwater predator with terrifying teeth and a reputation that may be doing most of the work.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.armoured_c: A whiskered bottom dweller wearing natural armor like it expects a boss fight at any moment.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.arapaima.d: One of the world's biggest freshwater fish because apparently regular-sized fish weren't impressive enough.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.cod.desc: A cold-water classic that has been feeding people for centuries and still hasn't asked for a raise.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.salmon.des: A determined fish that swims upstream fights rapids and refuses to accept that "going back" is a bad idea.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.herring.de: A small silver fish that travels in enormous groups because apparently personal space is overrated.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.wolffish.d: A cold-water predator with jaws and teeth that make it look like it has unresolved business with the ocean.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.skate.desc: A flat relative of rays that glides along the seafloor like an aquatic carpet with somewhere to be.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.black_seab: A sturdy coastal predator that spends its days hunting around reefs and rocky hideouts.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.monkfish.d: An ugly ambush predator that waves a little lure around and lets dinner come to it. Peak laziness honestly.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.opah.desc: A brilliantly colored fish that can keep much of its body warmer than the surrounding water. Basically wearing its own heated blanket.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.anchovy.de: A tiny silver fish that travels in enormous schools and somehow manages to be both small and extremely important.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.shad.desc: A schooling fish famous for seasonal migrations and the stubborn determination to make the trip every year.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.flying_fis: It doesn't technically fly but it launches out of the water and glides far enough to make the distinction feel petty.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.sturgeon.d: An ancient armored fish that grows enormous and looks like it was downloaded from the prehistoric DLC.
A powerful ocean predator carrying a giant sword on its face because apparently subtlety was never an option.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.rainbow_wr: A reef fish so colorful it looks like someone spilled an entire box of crayons into the ocean.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.gurnard.de: A strange bottom dweller with leg-like fins that make it look dangerously close to discovering walking.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.flounder.d: A fish that grows up to swim sideways and somehow ends up with both eyes on the same side. Problem solved apparently.
A fast colorful ocean predator that looks like it got dressed by a very enthusiastic artist.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.painted_mo: A boldly patterned reef eel with a permanent expression of "Go ahead. Make my day."
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.oarfish.de: A giant ribbon-shaped deep-sea fish that looks less like dinner and more like something sailors invented after seeing a nightmare.
A pale fish from the Pale Garden that looks like it hasn't seen sunlight since the beginning of time.
A mysterious eel from the Deep Dark that seems perfectly happy living somewhere every noise sounds ten times scarier.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.axolotl.de: You were fishing for fish. The axolotl has decided that technicalities are beneath it.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.bamboo.des: Not a fish. Not even remotely a fish. Your fishing rod is apparently branching into gardening.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.bowl.desc: An empty bowl suggesting the fish either escaped or was never invited to dinner.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.fish_bones: The fish escaped. Its skeleton apparently wasn't fast enough.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.frog.desc: You were aiming for a fish and somehow caught a frog. Fishing has become less specific.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.ink_sac.de: A suspiciously inky package from something that clearly wanted to leave no witnesses.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.leather.de: Not a fish not treasure but apparently the ocean's idea of a participation prize.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.lily_pad.d: A perfectly good lily pad. Not edible not a fish but excellent if you suddenly need pond furniture.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.string.des: Either a very unlucky spider or a fisherman having an unusually successful day.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.tadpole.de: Tiny wiggly and very much not ready to become dinner. Give it a few upgrades first.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.tripwire_h: Someone lost a trap and your fishing rod apparently decided to become a detective.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.water_bott: You went fishing and caught water. Technically a flawless catch. Nobody said it had to be interesting.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.enchanted_: A mysterious enchanted book pulled from the water. Hopefully the magic works better when dry.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.chest.desc: Someone buried a fortune down here and thought putting TNT next to the diamonds was perfectly reasonable.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.crystal_he: A mysterious crystal treasure that looks far too important to have been sitting at the bottom of a lake.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.emerald.de: An ancient coin dredged from the depths. Either treasure or someone's very expensive mistake.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.enchanted_: An enchanted fishing rod recovered from the depths. Even legendary fishermen apparently lose their gear.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.nautilus_s: A beautiful shell from the depths because the ocean apparently leaves souvenirs.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.tropical_f: A brilliantly colorful reef fish available in more patterns than anyone reasonably needs.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.pufferfish: A normally small fish that turns into a spiky balloon the moment things get awkward.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.pale_hangi: Pale Garden moss hanging overhead like the forest has grown an impressive collection of spooky curtains.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.resin_clum: A sticky orange clump of resin from the Pale Garden. Congratulations you caught tree goo.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.sculk_vein: A strange Deep Dark growth that spreads across surfaces like living darkness with absolutely no respect for personal space.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.echo_shard: A mysterious shard from an Ancient City carrying the memories of what it used to be...and probably several bad decisions.
adv.kleispack.anglers_almanac.sulfur_chu: A chunk that either means you're exploding into bits or getting sent up from a geyser. Or one step closer to crafting green dye. Not sure.
Because when you go fishing, the first thing you need is a loud way to let everyone know that you've caught the wrong fish again.
adv.kleispack.adventure.trade_with_carto: Buy a map from an Archaeologist
